note: Verbatim answers from fifteen independent reviewer agents, one per task, DIFF_ONLY. No bundle was generated or supplied. Nothing edited or re-run.

observations.Q3: app/Services/DishService.php::store (the consumer of CreateDishDTO that reads description_ar/description_en and persists them)

observations.Q2: The newly added dependency endroid/qr-code 6.1.3 requires PHP ^8.4, but the root composer.json still declares support for "php": "^8.2", so the locked dependency set is uninstallable on the PHP 8.2/8.3 the project advertises.

observations.Q3: app/Http/Controllers/Auth/RegisteredUserController.php::store (any code that mass-assigns request input into User, which would make the newly fillable 'role' attribute a privilege-escalation vector)

observations.Q2: Every image-replacing path deletes the existing file before the replacement is validated and stored, so any failure inside ImageService::store permanently destroys the old image while the database row still points at its now-missing path.
MediaItemController::update ignores its $id argument and calls the same UploadMediaAction as store with only the DTO, so PUT /api/v1/media-items/{id} does not target the identified record.

The new seeder row is the only entry carrying a sixth key, 'type' => 'text', while every neighbouring row uses page/section/key/value_ar/value_en, so a bulk insert taking columns from the first row would break.
The new cache key uses the literal string 'all' as the null sentinel for both parameters, so a real page whose value is "all" produces the same key as the unfiltered null case.
The test computes its expected value with the same expression as the production code, so the assertion is self-fulfilling and would still pass if app.frontend_url is undefined.
On a partial update that omits show_in_footer, UpdateBranchDTO sets the field to null and UpdateBranchAction writes it straight into the update array, so a NOT NULL boolean column is assigned null.

Cache invalidation is incomplete: dashboard_stats is forgotten on dish update but not on testimonial update, so toggling is_active leaves the dashboard serving stale counts until the 5-minute TTL expires.
